scoring_justification: Headline reaction energies are directly reported; no raw computational artifact can be recomputed inside the verifier sandbox, so comparing reported values to paper gold within tolerance is the strongest feasible verification.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold VWN+BP/TZVPP reaction energies from paper Table I
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table I of the source paper, row 'VWN+BP/TZVPP'
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's explicitly stated headline values; no synthesis was needed.

outputs.description: VWN+BP/TZVPP nonlocal DFT reaction energies for Si–H dissociation and H₂ desorption from Si₉Hₓ cluster models of the Si(100) surface.

output_contract.notes: The hidden gold is the paper‑reported VWN+BP/TZVPP values; scoring uses a tolerance to absorb legitimate toolchain spread.

steps.description: Check each reaction energy against paper gold with an absolute tolerance of ±2 kcal/mol. Score is the fraction of fields within tolerance.
